result.brief: 提出 MotionRep：用 DINO-VAE 压缩 DINO 特征为紧凑潜变量，并以扩散 Transformer 联合预测未来视觉表征与 3D 物体流，实现以语义-几何表征为未来状态空间的对象中心动力学世界模型。
result.reason: Predicts future DINO representations with a DINO-VAE compressing high-dimensional features into compact latents, plus 3D object flow; directly a visual representation world model contribution.
